verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that partitioning produces document elements with generic "metadata," and that the structured data extractor outputs custom-schema JSON. Nothing documents per-field provenance: no page numbers, bounding boxes, or source snippets attached to extracted fields for citation or verification. The generic metadata mention is adjacent, not the named capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, every extracted field carries provenance — page number, bounding box, source snippet — so agents can cite and humans can verify
